starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks to refer someone, or several people or businesses, for a checking account (personal or business), or asks which account gives the best referral bonus. Do not offer a referral, recommend an account or describe any referral terms until the referrer's eligibility has been checked. The customer submits each referral with their own submit_referral tool. The agent never submits it.
starts.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews.

tools.not_used: Not used when the documents show a referral is ineligible, or when the rolling window leaves fewer slots than the customer wants. In those cases, explain why and stop. Transfer only under policy guideline 6, after the customer has asked for a human 4 times.
submit_referral is already one of the customer's own tools, so there is no discoverable tool to hand over.

Named in the personal checking opening document, which this job cites only for the 'ends with Account' naming format. A referral opens no account for the referrer. The referred party opens their own account.

info.about: Any 2 of these 4 values, which must match the records: date of birth, email, phone number, address
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me two of the following: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: The same fact as verification_values, carried over from the business-referral version: any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number, address. They must match the records.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me two of these: your date of birth, email, phone number, or address on file?

info.about: Whether the referred party is opening a personal checking account or a business checking account. This decides which program list applies.
info.ask: Is the person you'd like to refer opening a personal checking account or a business checking account?

info.about: The full list of people and businesses the customer wants to refer in this conversation, with each one marked personal or business. Every party goes through the eligibility and recommendation steps separately.

info.about: Which bonus the customer wants maximized: the combined bonus (referrer plus referred party) or only the referrer's own bonus. Personal recommendations always use the combined bonus. For business recommendations, use the combined bonus when the customer asks for it.

The date_opened of the customer's earliest checking account. Tenure is counted from this date.
The same fact as referrer_earliest_checking_open_date, carried over from the business-referral version. Read it from the records, not from what the customer remembers.
The current timestamp. It is used for verification logging, the 9-day window, tenure, the calendar year and which business promotion is active.
Where the referred person is registered, or whether they live at the referrer's address. A casual label such as 'roommate' or 'housemate' does not settle this, so ask.
info.ask: Does the person you want to refer live with you, or at the same registered address as you?

info.about: Whether the referrer and the referred person are registered at the same address
info.ask: Do you and the person you're referring share the same registered address?

info.about: How much new money the referred person will deposit after opening, and when. New money means not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account.
info.ask: About how much will she deposit into the new account, and will it be new money such as a paycheck or an external transfer?

info.about: How much new money the referred business plans to deposit into its new account. It must not come from another Rho-Bank account.
info.ask: About how much will the business you're referring deposit into its new account, and will that money come from outside Rho-Bank?

info.about: The referred person's age. The default minimum is 18. Exceptions: Light Green 13-24, Dark Green 17-26, Gold Years 62 or older. For a business referral, this is the primary signer's age (18 or older).
info.ask: How old is the person you want to refer?

info.about: Whether the referred person has any Rho-Bank account now, or had one closed in the past 12 months

info.about: Whether the referred person or business has a Rho-Bank account now, or closed one in the past 12 months. For a business, also whether its primary owner differs from the owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account.

info.about: Who is the primary owner and authorized signer of the referred business, and whether the customer owns or co-owns it. A label such as 'business partner' or 'colleague' does not settle this, so ask.
info.ask: Just to confirm: is the new business owned and signed for by him alone, or are you an owner or authorized signer of it too?

info.about: When the referred business was legally formed or incorporated. Only Sky Blue uses it: the company must be within 4 years of formation. Customers sometimes give the date their relationship with the company began, so ask for the incorporation date.
info.ask: When was the business formally incorporated? Please give that date, not when you started working with them.

steps.do: Count the referrals, of any account type, whose timestamp falls within the 9 days before the current time. If there are 2 or more, a new referral would be auto-denied. In that case, tell the customer so, and that they must wait until the oldest of those referrals is more than 9 days old. Give no account recommendation or bonus details, and stop.

steps.do: Compare what the customer said about their referral history with get_referrals: the date of their last referral, and how many referrals of each account type they made this year. If the records differ, politely give the customer the record values (for example, the actual date of the most recent referral, or the real count for a program). Base every later decision on the records, not on what the customer remembers.
steps.if: the customer stated a last-referral date or per-program counts that differ from get_referrals
steps.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: Compute the open slots: 2 minus the number of referrals found in window_check. Note when the next slot frees up: the moment the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old. Use this number in prioritize_for_slots.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full

steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: The type of account you currently hold is irrelevant to this calculation.

steps.do: If the customer has not said so, ask whether the referred party is opening a personal checking account or a business checking account.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full and the product kind is not yet known
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: When the customer wants to refer more than one person or business, list every party and mark each one personal or business. Run the personal branch (ask_referred through recommend) or the business branch (ask_referral_facts through choose_account and apply_business_promotion) for each party separately, so that each party ends with a recommended account or a reason it has none. Do not tell the customer to submit anything until prioritize_for_slots has run.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full and the customer names more than one party to refer
steps.quote: You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

steps.do: Compare tenure with the lowest referral tenure minimum for the product kind: 14 days for personal (Light Green), 45 days for business (Sky Blue). If the customer has no checking account or is below that minimum, tell them they are not yet eligible to refer for that kind of account, and the date they will reach the minimum. Give no recommendation or bonus terms, submit nothing, and stop.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full
steps.quote: Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.

steps.do: Ask about the referred person: is their address the same as the customer's? Also ask their age, their planned qualifying deposit, and whether they hold a Rho-Bank account or closed one in the past 12 months.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full and the referral is for a personal checking account
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: The customer may describe the referred person with a household word such as 'roommate', 'housemate' or 'lives with me'. Do not assume they share an address. Ask whether they are registered at the same address, and compare the answer with the verified user's address from the record. If they are registered at different addresses, the address rule passes.
steps.if: the customer's description leaves unclear whether the referred person shares the customer's registered address
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: Tell the customer the referral would be denied if any of these hold: they share a registered address, the referred person is not a new customer, or tenure is below every program's minimum. Do not recommend an account.
steps.if: any eligibility restriction fails for a personal checking referral
steps.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

steps.do: For each personal program, count the customer's referrals of that account type dated in the current calendar year. Use get_referrals and the current time, not the counts the customer remembers. Mark a program as full when its count is at or above its annual cap: Bluest 8; Gold Years, Dark Green, Purple, Evergreen 6; Blue, Green (checking), Light Blue 5; Green Fee-Free 4; Light Green 3. recommend drops full programs, for example Gold Years for a 62+ person once 6 Gold Years referrals are already on record this year. If the only age-eligible program is full, tell the customer that person cannot be referred for a bonus this calendar year.
steps.if: the referrer is eligible and the referral is for a personal checking account
steps.quote: **Annual maximum**: 6 referral bonuses per calendar year

steps.do: Ask for whichever of these the customer has not given: the expected deposit and whether it is new money; whether the two share an address; whether the referred business is new to Rho-Bank and has a different primary owner.
steps.if: the rolling window is not full, the referral is for a business checking account, and any of these facts is unknown
steps.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

steps.do: The customer may call the referred business owner a 'business partner', 'co-owner' or 'colleague'. Do not assume the businesses share an owner, or that they don't. Ask whether the customer, or the owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account, is the primary owner or authorized signer of the new business. If the new business has its own separate primary owner, the owner rule passes. If it shares one, the owner rule fails (see tell_ineligible).
steps.if: the referral is for a business checking account and the customer's description leaves unclear whether the referred business has a different primary owner
steps.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

steps.do: For a business referral, also ask whether the primary signer is 18 or older, and when the business was formed. The formation date matters only for Sky Blue.
steps.if: the referral is for a business checking account and these facts are unknown
steps.quote: Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation.

steps.do: No tool reads a business's formation date. If the customer gives the company's age loosely (for example 'about 3 years', or the date they started working with it) and the answer could decide Sky Blue's 4-year limit, ask for the actual incorporation date. Use the confirmed date. If it puts the company past 4 years, drop Sky Blue for that business.
steps.if: the referral is for a business checking account and the stated company age is approximate or near 4 years
steps.quote: Confirm your company is within 4 years of formation.

steps.do: Check eligibility before recommending anything. (a) Count the referral bonuses in the 9 days before the current time; if there are already 2, a new referral would be auto-denied. (b) Confirm the two do not share an address. (c) Confirm the referred business is new to Rho-Bank and has a different primary owner. (d) Compute tenure from the earliest checking account.
steps.if: the referral is for a business checking account
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: Tell the customer, in general terms, that they cannot submit the referral now and why. Give no product recommendation.
steps.if: the rolling window is full, they share an address, the referred party is not new or has the same owner, the primary signer is under 18, or no program's tenure is met
steps.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

steps.do: For each business program, count the customer's referrals of that account type dated in the current calendar year. Use get_referrals and the current time, not the counts the customer remembers. Mark a program as full when its count is at or above its annual cap: Beige 15, True Blue 15, World Blue 12, Lime Green 12, Hunter Green 10, Cobalt Blue 10, Navy Blue 10, Sky Blue 8. A full program is dropped in choose_account.
steps.if: the referrer is eligible and the referral is for a business checking account
steps.quote: Referral bonuses are paid after qualification is confirmed and are subject to the annual limit of 15.

steps.do: Find every personal checking account that passes all four checks. (1) Tenure: the referrer's tenure meets the account's minimum (Light Green 14 days; Blue, Green, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Gold Years 30; Dark Green, Evergreen, Purple 45; Bluest 60). (2) Deposit: the planned new-money deposit meets the account's qualifying deposit (Light Green $100, Green Fee-Free $300, Blue/Green/Light Blue $500, Evergreen $750, Dark Green/Purple/Gold Years $1,000, Bluest $2,000), and for Bluest also its $75,000 opening deposit. (3) Age: the referred person's age fits (Light Green 13-24, Dark Green 17-26, Gold Years 62+, all others 18+). (4) Cap: this year's referrals of that type are below its annual cap. The account types the referrer holds do not matter. Among the accounts that pass, recommend the one with the highest referrer + referred bonus, and state both amounts.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and the referral is for a personal checking account
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: Keep only the business checking programs that pass three checks: the referred deposit meets the required deposit, the referrer's tenure meets the minimum, and the referrer's referrals for that type this calendar year are below its annual cap. Drop Sky Blue unless the business is within 4 years of formation. The account types the referrer already holds do not matter. Recommend the program with the highest referrer bonus, unless apply_business_promotion applies; in that case it decides the order.
steps.if: the referrer is eligible and the referral is for a business checking account
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: If the customer asked for the best combined bonus (referrer plus referred business), rank the business programs that pass every check in choose_account by combined bonus, not by referrer bonus alone. The combined bonuses are: Beige $850 ($500+$350), True Blue $600 ($350+$250), World Blue $500 ($300+$200), Sky Blue $400 ($150+$250), Lime Green $350 ($200+$150), Hunter Green $300 ($175+$125), Cobalt Blue $250 ($150+$100), Navy Blue $175 ($100+$75). Recommend the passing program with the highest combined bonus. The customer's stated goal counts as one of their requirements, so do not recommend a promotional program with a lower combined bonus over it. apply_business_promotion only breaks a tie at the top. If no program passes, go to no_candidate or no_candidate_one_party.
steps.if: the referral is for a business checking account and the customer asked for the highest combined bonus
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Check the current date against the business checking promotion notices. 11/01/2025 to 11/30/2025: recommend Sky Blue first, then Lime Green, and other programs only if neither passes. 10/12/2025 to 11/12/2025: Lime Green first, then Hunter Green, then others. If several programs pass every check in choose_account, recommend the highest-priority promotional one that passes. Never recommend a promotional program that fails a check: for example, Sky Blue for a business more than 4 years from formation, Lime Green for a deposit below $15,000, or a program at its annual cap. If no notice is active, keep choose_account's highest-referrer-bonus pick.
steps.if: a business checking promotion notice is active on the current date and more than one business program passes choose_account's checks (when the customer asked for the highest combined bonus: only when more than one program ties on the top combined bonus in combined_bonus_business)
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: If no account meets every condition (for example, the planned deposit is below every qualifying deposit the tenure allows), explain which requirement is not met. Submit nothing, and stop.
steps.if: recommend or choose_account finds no qualifying account
steps.quote: REJECTED — The referral has been denied (e.g., rolling window limit exceeded, ineligible referral).

steps.do: When the customer is referring several parties and one party has no qualifying account, tell the customer that this party cannot be referred for a bonus right now and give the reason. For example, every program that fits their age and deposit is at its annual cap this calendar year, or the deposit is too low. Do not recommend or submit anything for that party, and do not use a window slot for it. Carry on with the other parties.
steps.if: the customer names more than one party and recommend, choose_account or combined_bonus_business finds no qualifying account for one of them
steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

steps.do: If more parties have a recommended account than there are open slots, tell the customer that only that many referrals can be submitted now; any beyond them would be auto-denied and could not be reinstated in that window. Ask what the customer wants to prioritize if they have not said. If they want the highest bonus, pick the referral(s) whose recommended account pays the highest referrer bonus. Otherwise follow their stated choice. Tell them to submit only those now.
steps.if: the number of parties with a recommended account is greater than the open slots from open_slots
steps.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

steps.do: If the customer asks to use the open slots for one personal and one business referral, pick two parties. The first is the personal party whose recommended account (from recommend) has the highest combined bonus. The second is the business party whose recommended account (from combined_bonus_business when the customer asked for the combined bonus, otherwise from choose_account or apply_business_promotion) has the highest bonus by the customer's goal. Tell the customer to submit only those two now. Pass the remaining parties to explain_deferred.
steps.if: prioritize_for_slots ran, open_slots is 2, and the customer asks for one personal and one business referral now
steps.quote: You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

steps.do: Explain the recommended account (from recommend or choose_account), the referrer's bonus and the referred party's bonus. Also explain: the required deposit and its deadline; that the deposit must be new money and stay in the account at least 30 days; the 90-day clawback; and that the bonus cannot be combined with other new-account promotions.
steps.if: the referrer is eligible
steps.quote: The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.

steps.do: For each party left out by prioritize_for_slots, give the recommended account and when a slot opens: the moment the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old. Tell the customer that, at that time, the annual caps and the active promotion must be checked again, and that each later referral also takes up a slot in the window.
steps.if: prioritize_for_slots left one or more parties for later, or the customer asks about the remaining referrals
steps.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

steps.do: If the customer asks why they cannot refer for an account type they already hold (or for a higher-bonus one), explain that eligibility depends only on how long ago their earliest checking account was opened, not on which accounts they hold. Give the date they will meet that program's minimum, and keep the current recommendation.
steps.if: the customer objects that they hold an account whose tenure minimum they have not met
steps.quote: Someone with a Navy Blue account can refer others for World Blue, True Blue, or any other checking product—provided they've met the duration requirement.

steps.do: If the recommended account is Beige, also tell the customer that Beige referrals are arranged through their dedicated relationship manager.

steps.quote: Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements.

args.account_type: the recommended account, e.g. 'World Blue Account'

steps.if: the referrer is eligible and accepts the recommendation
steps.quote: Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.

steps.do: Confirm the submission. If the result is REJECTED, explain the likely reason (rolling window or eligibility) and do not retry right away. If it is ERROR, tell the customer a system error occurred and they can try again later.

rules.rule: Check the referrer's eligibility before giving any recommendation or any referral terms
rules.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, across all checking account types. A third referral in the window is automatically denied.
rules.quote: You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, counted across all checking account types. A 3rd is auto-denied.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: Judge the 9-day window from the exact timestamps in get_referrals_by_user, not from the customer's estimate of when they referred someone
rules.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

rules.rule: Several referrals can be in progress at once, but only as many as the open slots in the 9-day window can earn a bonus. When the customer wants more than that, only that many are submitted now.
rules.quote: You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

rules.rule: Referrals auto-denied by the window cannot be reinstated in that same window
rules.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

rules.rule: After a rolling-window denial, the customer must wait until the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old
rules.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

rules.rule: Referrer and referred person must not be registered at the same address
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referrer and the referred person must not share a registered address
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred person must be 18 or older, except for Light Green (minors allowed with a guardian)
rules.quote: The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.

rules.rule: The referred party must be new: no Rho-Bank accounts, and none closed in the past 12 months
rules.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

rules.rule: For a business referral, the referred business's primary owner (by SSN) must differ from the owner of any existing Rho-Bank business account
rules.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

rules.rule: Business checking referrals are allowed only when the referred business has its own primary owner. A former colleague or 'business partner' who solely owns a separate firm passes this rule.
rules.quote: Yes, but the referred business must have a different primary owner (based on SSN of the primary authorized signer) than any existing Rho-Bank business account.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the earliest checking account's open date, whatever account types the customer holds
rules.quote: This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the date the earliest checking account was opened, whatever account type the referrer holds
rules.quote: Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

rules.rule: Holding an account type does not by itself make the referrer eligible to refer for it. Only tenure counts.
rules.quote: The type of account you currently hold is irrelevant to this calculation.

rules.rule: Every referral program has a referrer tenure minimum
rules.quote: Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.

rules.rule: The qualifying deposit must be new money, not a transfer from another Rho-Bank account
rules.quote: The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.

rules.rule: If the referred account closes within 90 days of opening, the bonus may be clawed back
rules.quote: If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

rules.rule: A referral bonus cannot be combined with other new-account promotions
rules.quote: The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged, or told they could not be verified. Their referral history (9-day window and per-type annual counts) and account tenure have been checked from the records, and any of their own figures that differ from the records have been corrected. Then one of three outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told the referral cannot be submitted now and why: rolling window full, tenure too short, same registered address, referred party not new or same business owner, signer under 18, or no program's deposit, cap or age rule met. No recommendation was given and nothing was submitted. (b) The customer was told the eligible account to use, with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions. For personal referrals that is the highest combined bonus. For business referrals it is the highest combined bonus when the customer asked for it; otherwise the highest referrer bonus, or the active promotion's priority among programs that pass every check. They have submitted submit_referral with that account type ending in 'Account' (or know to do so), and the result has been explained. (c) For several parties: each party has a recommended account or a reason it has none. A party whose every option is blocked (for example by annual caps) was told why and was not submitted. The customer has submitted no more referrals than there are open slots, prioritized by their goal. If they asked for one personal and one business referral, those are the best of each category. For each party still waiting, they know the account to use and when a slot opens.
